title: ci: add positron api tests
description: Adds a real-Positron integration test alongside the existing mocked VS Code suite. `src/test/positron/` boots a downloaded Positron build (via `@posit-dev/positron-test-electron`) and checks the extension activates and the live Positron API is reachable. Run locally with `npm run test-positron`; CI runs it on PRs and pushes to `main` via the `posit-dev/setup-positron action`.
